mapper.update: UPDATE T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO t1 JOIN ( SELECT r.FACTORY_CODE, r.MATERIAL_CODE, r.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, r.EMBRYO_CODE FROM ( SELECT t.*, -- 分组变量：判断是否为同一组，重置行号 @rn := IF(@statusGroup = CONCAT(t.FACTORY_CODE, '_', t.MATERIAL_CODE), @rn + 1, 1) AS rn, @statusGroup := CONCAT(t.FACTORY_CODE, '_', t.MATERIAL_CODE) AS group_flag FROM ( -- 先按优先级排序（S>T>X），保证同组内优先级高的排在前 SELECT FACTORY_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, EMBRYO_CODE FROM T_MDM_SKU_CONSTRUCTION_REF WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 ORDER BY FACTORY_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, CASE TRIAL_STATUS WHEN 'S' THEN 1 WHEN 'T' THEN 2 WHEN 'X' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ASC ) t, (SELECT @rn := 0, @statusGroup := '') AS temp ) r WHERE r.rn = 1 ) t2 ON t1.FACTORY_CODE = t2.FACTORY_CODE AND t1.MATERIAL_CODE = t2.MATERIAL_CODE SET t1.EMBRYO_DESC = t2.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, t1.EMBRYO_CODE = t2.EMBRYO_CODE, t1.UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy}, t1.UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime} WHERE t1.IS_DELETE = 0

UPDATE T_MDM_SKU_CONSTRUCTION_REF mscr JOIN T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO info ON mscr.MATERIAL_CODE = info.MATERIAL_CODE AND info.IS_DELETE = 0 SET mscr.MATERIAL_DESC = info.MATERIAL_DESC WHERE mscr.IS_DELETE = 0 AND mscr.MATERIAL_DESC IS NULL
